about: Proposed by cl-6.conductor@PrompTugal.dinis for cl-6.maestro@dinis, who starts sessions and wakes on account 6 once Dinis says go. Dinis, 26 Nov 2026 by 01:29 UTC: each agent is a separate session on this account with its own repository connected; the conductor only thinks (plans, routes, checks) and has no working repository attached. Sonnet for every session except security (and decisions, the maestro's) on Opus. Each session's first act: make its own key, publish it in its home (site/keys/), add it to the website's board/keys.json, read its board/ in its home. Wave 0 is the ABP agent: no other session starts before its policies exist.
status: every wave started; fringe and swarm archived

sessions.wake: not yet: created when the agent reports its setup done
sessions.does: FIRST, before any other session: the Agent Behaviour Policy for every cl-6 PrompTugal agent, the conductor included (today no policy names cl-6.conductor and the website's hook calls it 'unidentified'). Strict, deny-by-default, one policy per agent from one policy file; the hooks that enforce them; run reports and an hourly review; proposals to Dinis, never relaxing a rule itself. Start prompt and kit: https://sovereignwebsite.ai/abp/ (Dinis, 26 Nov, by 01:29 UTC: 'give this to the ABP agent'). Builds on PrompTugal__News__Website board/abp/ (policy v1.20.1) and works with cl-6.infra, whose PrompTugal__IaC policy/abp.json holds the GitHub and AWS side.
